Assistant ProfessorB.A. (English, Psychology, Sociology), M.A. English Linkedin Link Ms. Soujannya D. is a dedicated educator with a decade of experience in English literature and soft skills development. She holds a Bachelor’s degree in English, Psychology and Sociology, and a Master’s degree in English. Apart from her academic expertise, Ms. Soujanya is a trained Hindustani Classical singer and has had her poetry published in several magazines. She is passionate about enhancing students' literary and communication skills. Specialisations and Interests Humanities Publications and Career Highlights Technology, Arts and Aesthetics: A Literary and Social Transformation – International Conference on Literature, Languages, and Linguistics Studies, Feb 2024.
